stem: One environmental consequence of the large-scale cultivation of cotton in the South was —

options.label: A
options.text: widespread soil exhaustion caused by decades of farming

options.label: B
options.text: drought caused by overuse of river water to irrigate farmland

options.label: C
options.text: air pollution caused by the use of cotton gins

options.label: D
options.text: widespread water contamination caused by fertilizer runoff
